title: Discovery of anti-stroke active substances in Guhong injection based on multi-phenotypic screening of zebrafish.
authors: Wang, Yule; Wu, Huimin; Sheng, Hongda; Wang, Yingchao; Li, Xuecai; Wang, Yi; Zhao, Lu
one_liner_zh: 该文用斑马鱼模型筛选中药注射液的抗中风活性成分，仅以分子对接粗测小分子与凝血因子/NF-kB亲和力，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Ischemic stroke is a leading cause of death worldwide, and it remains an urgent task to develop novel and alternative therapeutic strategies for the disease. We previously reported the positive effects of Guhong injection (GHI), composed of safflower extract and aceglutamide, in promoting functional recovery in ischemic stroke mice. However, the active substances and pharmacological mechanism of GHI is still elusive. Aiming to identify the active anti-stroke components in GHI, here we conducted a multi-phenotypic screening in zebrafish models of phenylhydrazine-induced thrombosis and ponatinib-induced cerebral ischemia. Peripheral and cerebral blood flow was quantified endogenously in erythrocytes fluorescence-labeled thrombosis fish, and baicalein and rutin were identified as major anti-thrombotic substances in GHI. Moreover, using a high-throughput video-tracking system, the effects of locomotion promotion of GHI and its main compounds were analyzed in cerebral ischemia model. Chlorogenic acid and gallic acid showed significant effects in preventing locomotor dyfunctions. Finally, GHI treatment greatly decreased the expression levels of coagulation factors F7 and F2, NF-kappaB and its mediated proin fl ammatory cytokines in the fish models. Molecular docking suggested strong affinities between baicalein and F7, and between active substances (baicalein, chlorogenic acid, gallic acid, and rutin) and NF-kappaB p65. In summary, our findings established a novel drug discovery method based on multi-phenotypic screening of zebrafish, provided endogenous evidences of GHI in preventing thrombus formation and promoting behavioral recovery after cerebral ischemia, and identified baicalein, rutin, chlorogenic acid, and gallic acid as active compounds in the management of ischemic stroke.
abstract_zh: 缺血性卒中是全球范围内的主要死亡原因，开发新型且替代性的治疗策略仍是当务之急。我们此前报道了由红花提取物和乙酰谷酰胺组成的谷红注射液（GHI）在促进缺血性卒中小鼠功能恢复中的积极作用。然而，GHI的活性物质及其药理机制仍不明确。为鉴定GHI中的抗卒中活性成分，本研究在斑马鱼模型中进行了多表型筛选，包括苯肼诱导的血栓形成和普纳替尼诱导的脑缺血模型。通过红细胞荧光标记的血栓鱼模型内源性量化外周及脑部血流，鉴定出黄芩素和芦丁为GHI中的主要抗血栓物质。此外，利用高通量视频追踪系统，在脑缺血模型中分析了GHI及其主要化合物对运动促进的作用。绿原酸和没食子酸在预防运动功能障碍方面表现出显著效果。最后，GHI处理显著降低了鱼模型中凝血因子F7和F2、NF-kappaB及其介导的促炎细胞因子的表达水平。分子对接提示黄芩素与F7之间，以及活性物质（黄芩素、绿原酸、没食子酸和芦丁）与NF-kappaB p65之间具有强亲和力。总之，我们的发现建立了一种基于斑马鱼多表型筛选的新型药物发现方法，提供了GHI在预防血栓形成和促进脑缺血后行为恢复方面的内源性证据，并鉴定出黄芩素、芦丁、绿原酸和没食子酸为治疗缺血性卒中的活性化合物。
